LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.0.label: 微熱的愉悅
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.0.description: 體內泛起暖意，身體感到一絲愉悅。
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.1.label: 慾望升溫
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.1.description: 溫熱的感覺和持續的慾望讓我沉浸其中。
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.2.label: 感官沉醉
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.2.description: 感官逐漸模糊，強烈的快感讓我暫時忘記煩惱。
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.3.label: 強烈陶醉
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.3.description: 洶湧的慾望佔據了注意力，我幾乎無法思考其他事情。
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.4.label: 過載的愉悅
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.4.description: 過量的刺激淹沒了意識，身體只剩下難以承受的愉悅。
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.0.label: 輕盈的暖意
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.0.descr: 奈米機械開始活躍，身體輕快而溫暖。
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.1.label: 活化的喜悅
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.1.descr: 身體中的活力逐漸充盈，讓我感到愉快而清醒。
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.2.label: 充盈的活力
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.2.descr: 神經與奈米機械一同活躍，身體充滿力量與愉悅。
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.3.label: 共鳴的愉悅
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.3.descr: 強烈的活化讓身體與奈米機械共鳴，行動也變得格外輕快。
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.4.label: 極限活化的滿足
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.4.descr: 身體被活力與快感充滿，我正處於最強烈的活化狀態。
